strategicMoves.title: Launch an 'Offline-First' Feature Campaign
strategicMoves.detail: Develop and promote a dedicated offline mode with seamless sync, positioning KeenFox as the only lightweight tool that works reliably in low-connectivity scenarios. Highlight this in all messaging to counter Notion’s weakness.
strategicMoves.basedOnCompetitorSignal: Notion’s lack of robust offline functionality is a key pain point for users.

strategicMoves.title: Introduce Transparent Pricing Tiers with No Seat Minimums
strategicMoves.detail: Revamp pricing to offer flexible, transparent tiers with no forced seat buckets. Promote this as a direct counter to Monday’s pricing frustrations and Asana’s enterprise-focused costs.
strategicMoves.basedOnCompetitorSignal: Monday’s pricing model frustrates customers with inflexible license buckets, and Asana’s pricing is seen as prohibitive for smaller teams.

strategicMoves.title: Develop a 'KeenFox Lite' Plan for Small Teams
strategicMoves.detail: Create a stripped-down, low-cost plan targeting small teams and startups frustrated by Asana’s complexity and ClickUp’s feature bloat. Position it as the 'no-nonsense' alternative.
strategicMoves.basedOnCompetitorSignal: Asana’s complexity and ClickUp’s steep learning curve alienate smaller teams.

strategicMoves.title: Partner with Offline-First Tools for Co-Marketing
strategicMoves.detail: Collaborate with tools like Obsidian or Logseq (offline-first note-taking) to cross-promote KeenFox as the productivity tool that works seamlessly offline. Leverage their audiences to highlight KeenFox’s reliability.
strategicMoves.basedOnCompetitorSignal: Notion’s offline limitations create an opportunity to partner with tools that prioritize offline functionality.

strategicMoves.title: Launch a 'No AI Tax' Guarantee
strategicMoves.detail: Introduce a pledge to never charge extra for AI features, positioning KeenFox as the cost-effective alternative to Notion and ClickUp. Promote this in all pricing and comparison messaging.
strategicMoves.basedOnCompetitorSignal: Notion’s AI add-on pricing and ClickUp’s AI-driven messaging risk alienating cost-sensitive users.
